instruction: For every conversation record in the assigned JSON files, inventory every key by its exact name and JSON value type. Include keys at all nesting depths. Use only these JSON types: object, array, string, number, boolean, null. Do not include or reproduce field values, infer semantics, or omit keys because they are uncommon.
